scratchScope: The 112-byte private TypeScript motion/output scratch models original stack storage and is cleared before exporting caller arena bytes. Every captured motion byte supplied to downstream services is recorded and compared; original object memory, steering state and service trace bytes are not excluded.
scope: Whole ordinary bird/manta target-distance, target-force and guide-force callers, raw/Wander accumulation and Flee force. Original Seek and shared Flocking execute in the same chain. World raycast/neighborhood, metadata, Avatar state and owners remain explicit services. Raw target/guide forces, landing probe selection and original shared Flocking are composed with acceleration, Steering.Begin/End, flight, motion and Model.SetTransform in BirdV2.Update. Rail choice/follow, object-follow, direction interpolation/bank, world collision and real resource owners remain explicit boundaries. Complete caller arena and ordered services compared, including consecutive frames and live callback changes. Original acosf/sincosf/powf inputs and outputs are recorded and replayed as explicit math services; no JavaScript/libm equivalence claim.
